headline: Iranian Hardliners Push for Nuclear Weapons Amid Simmering Conflict With US
summary: Sitting lawmakers and security officials in Iran have made public calls for the development of nuclear weapons as regional tensions persist.
why: Escalating nuclear proliferation risks in the Middle East heighten geopolitical instability and directly influence global crude oil supply risk premiums.

impacts.name: Global Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Increased geopolitical tensions in the Middle East heighten potential risks to regional energy infrastructure.
